description: Gemini CLI detection rules, from the glyphs it puts in its title.

rules.why: Gemini CLI puts ✋ in its title while a tool waits for permission.
Gemini CLI puts ✦ (or ⏲ when silent) in its title while a turn runs.
Gemini CLI marks rest with ◇ in its title, a glyph it never shows mid-turn.
